brief: Long low frame shed about 30 ft by 80 ft, the rightmost building in the example view: unpainted horizontal wood siding weathered to brown-grey, a new pale-grey steel gable roof, a large open drive-in doorway in the gable end and a regular row of small square windows along the long side. Reused here as the machine and hay-rack shed. It sits on a grassy rise beside a smaller broken-gable granary, a chicken house and a red-and-white shop, prairie grass all around.
